prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original editorial traveler avatar for a Korean travel journal app profile. Bust portrait of a fictional adult East Asian woman, short dark wavy bob, warm open expression, cobalt blue lightweight jacket, coral-orange camera strap, holding a small travel notebook. Graphic screenprint illustration, confident navy ink contours, restrained flat color planes and subtle paper grain. Contemporary independent travel magazine style. NOT 3D, NOT clay, NOT chibi, NOT animal mascot. Square composition, entire head hair shoulders and notebook inside generous margins suitable for rounded-square crop. Color palette cobalt #254DC4, ink #172D4A, ice blue #DDE8FA, orange #ED9B6B, natural warm skin. Transparent background outside the subject; actual alpha, no white rectangle. No letters, no typography, no logos, no watermark.
